recorder.systemAudioToggle: Record the sound of the PC
win.recording.discardConfirm: Click again to delete this recording
win.recording.windowClosed: The window was closed, so the recording stopped.
win.recording.displayChanged: The display changed, so the recording stopped.
win.recording.captureLost: Screen capture stopped unexpectedly. What was recorded is kept.
win.recording.captureUnsupported: Screen recording needs Windows 10 version 2004 or later.
win.recording.encoderMissing: Screen recording needs the Windows media components. On Windows N editions, add the Media Feature Pack in Settings > Apps > Optional features.
win.recording.systemAudioUnavailable: The PC sound can’t be recorded right now
win.recording.frameRateCaption: 60 fps is smoother, 30 fps makes smaller files. A still screen costs almost nothing either way.
win.recording.showIndicatorCaption: A small bar with the time, pause, stop and discard floats near the top of the screen. It never appears in the recording.
win.recording.shortcutCaption: Starts a recording, or stops the one in progress.
win.recording.microphoneBlockedCaption: Turn on “Let desktop apps access your microphone” in Windows Settings to record your voice.
win.recording.editorMissing: The recording editor is not installed, so recordings are saved straight away.
win.recording.directSaveNote: Recordings saved straight away keep their sound but have no pointer: only the editor draws it.
